title: Outcome
description: issues/<id>/library/outcome.json: how one issue ended. Written once by the dispatcher after it sees the issue finished (done); never rewritten and never by hand. No file means it did not collect. Not written for a person's issue (who: person). Read by the retro; no gate or dispatcher decision reads it. Only these keys.

issue.description: The issue the record is about.

result.description: merged: the pull request was merged. closed: it was closed without merging. open: the issue was finished while it was still open. none: the issue had no pull request (report.json has no pr). Read from GitHub after the finish.

pr.description: The pull request (report.json's pr), or null when result is none.

merge_commit.description: The merge commit on GitHub. null unless result is merged (or GitHub did not give one).

merged_at.description: When GitHub merged it. null unless result is merged (or GitHub did not give it).

gates.description: The gate's last decision for each head (library/gate/<head>.json), oldest first. Empty when the gate never wrote a record.

reviewers.description: How many reviewer child issues (parent is this issue, profile *-review) the ledger has.

worked_minutes.description: Working time up to the last done, without the waits (the same as andon metrics show: questions open, reviews, dead terminals).

sessions.description: One entry per harness session in the launch record (library/launches.jsonl), in launch order. null when the issue has no launch record (it was started before launch records existed).

breakdown.description: How the issue's own harness records (the otel store's issues/<id>/, docs/contract.md section 30) break down, summed when the dispatcher wrote this record, so the numbers outlive the raw records (kept 30 days). Only this issue's records: a reviewer's issue has its own breakdown and is not in its parent's. null when the store has no line for the issue (or it could not be read; the dispatcher logs that). Optional: records written before breakdown existed have no key. The token counts are separate from sessions[].cost (not dollars).

time.description: UTC time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, a real calendar date and time.

id.description: A ledger issue id: no /, \ or :, and not . or ...

sha.description: A full git commit id: 40 lowercase hex digits.

head.description: The pull request head the gate judged.

at.description: When the gate read the head's GitHub checks.

tier.description: Tier of the change: A, B or C.

reasons.description: The decision function's reasons, one line each. Empty on approve.

session.description: One harness session and its cost.
The session id: the launch record's for Claude Code, the rollout's session_meta id for Codex (found by the issue's working directories, since Codex has no id at launch). null when there is none.

cost.description: Read from the session log when the dispatcher wrote this record, or null when the log was not found (Claude Code deletes logs after 30 days) or a Claude Code log file or its subagents folder could not be read through (not measured, unlike a session with zero tokens).
Counted the same way as andon metrics show's tokens.

models.description: Model ids the session actually used (subagents included), in order of first use. Claude Code's <synthetic> is not a model.

efforts.description: Reasoning efforts the session ran at, in order of first use. Empty when the log does not say.

turns.description: Turns: Claude Code's distinct promptId on the main line, Codex's distinct turn_id. null when the log has no such mark.

input.description: Input tokens neither read from nor written to the cache.

cache_read.description: Input tokens read from the cache.

cache_write.description: Input tokens written to the cache.

tokens.description: Token counts, the same as andon metrics show's (not dollars).

breakdown.description: Counts from the harness spans. A subagent's spans are under its parent session's spans and count for the same issue.

role.description: The role of the issue's last launch record line; with no launch record, the records' andon.role resource attribute when it is a launch role; else null.

coverage.description: How many of the issue's sessions (the entries of sessions[]; 0 when sessions is null) have at least one span, matched by the span's session.id, gen_ai.conversation.id or conversation.id.

traced.description: Entries whose session id some span carries.

llm_ms.description: Milliseconds of all claude_code.llm_request spans, a subagent's included.

tool_ms.description: Milliseconds of the claude_code.tool spans that are not under another tool span (a tool that runs a subagent counts the time inside it). Tools run side by side each count.

blocked_ms.description: Milliseconds of claude_code.tool.blocked_on_user spans (waiting on the permission check).

tokens.description: Summed from the claude_code.llm_request spans' input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens and cache_creation_tokens.

input.description: Input tokens neither read from nor written to the cache.

cache_read.description: Input tokens read from the cache.

cache_write.description: Input tokens written to the cache.

errors.description: Failed spans: success false or status ERROR (for a tool, also a failed claude_code.tool.execution under it).

tools.description: claude_code.tool spans (at any depth) by tool name and, for Bash, first word; the 10 longest, longest first.

waits.description: Waiting time inside the issue's doing time, by kind (kinds may overlap).

question_ms.description: The issue's own questions open (the same as worked_minutes leaves out).

review_ms.description: Waiting for reviewer child issues (the same as worked_minutes leaves out).

ci_ms.description: Bash tool spans whose full command waits for the pull request checks (gh pr checks, gh run watch), overlaps counted once.

gone_ms.description: The issue's terminal dead (the same as worked_minutes leaves out).

knowledge.description: Wiki reads (ADR-0061): the cell wiki's pages and index the issue's sessions read, counted from claude_code.tool spans: a Read span's file_path, and the paths a Bash span's full_command names (under the wiki store's absolute path, or wiki/ after a word break). One tool span counts a page once. Pages are the .md files under entities/, topics/ and sources/, and overview.md; log.md and raw/ are not counted. Absent when the breakdown has no claude_code span (a Codex record carries no paths: no record, not zero reads), and in records written before this key existed.

index_reads.description: Tool spans that read the wiki index (index.md), kept apart from the pages.

pages.description: Pages read at least once, most reads first, then by path.

argv0.description: For Bash, the command's first word (bash_argv0, or the first word of full_command); otherwise null.

path.description: The page's path relative to the wiki store (topics/tool-quirks.md).

reads.description: Tool spans that read the page.
